agent reported a spec/test contradiction:
# BLOCKED: P1.1 (Amira + Mateo fixtures)

Frozen tests contradict each other. I cannot edit either file, so I stopped.

## Contradiction

- `tests/test_lanes.py::test_cli_demo_prints_a_profile_line_per_review` (P0.12, frozen)
  - It asserts `profile_lines == [PROFILE_LINE, PROFILE_LINE]`: `cli demo` prints exactly two `profile:` lines, one for each of Robert's two reviews.
  - Its docstring says "Amira/Mateo fixtures are incomplete".
- `tests/test_personas.py::test_demo_now_reviews_three_complete_personas` (P1.1, frozen), plus the task text ("the demo test in tests/test_pipeline_offline.py now sees three complete personas")
  - It requires `cli demo` to review robert, amira and mateo, with no "incomplete" notice.
  - Every review then prints a `profile:` line (SPEC §12, spec-factors §20.9), so `cli demo` prints 4 lines.

Once `fixtures/amira` and `fixtures/mateo` are complete (which `tests/test_personas.py` requires), the old test must fail. Its own premise, "Amira/Mateo fixtures are incomplete", is no longer true.

## Measured

With the new fixtures, `COHERENCE_ANALYZER_LLM=mock python -m pytest -q` gives 929 passed and 1 failed. `tests/test_personas.py` passes in full, with no skips. The one failure is:

```
tests/test_lanes.py::test_cli_demo_prints_a_profile_line_per_review
  assert ['profile: wa...rofile: pass'] == ['profile: wa...g (C1, N6.1)']   (2 extra lines: "profile: info (N6.1)", "profile: pass")
```

`cli demo` prints:

- robert (current): `profile: warning (C1, N6.1)`
- robert (review): `profile: warning (C1, N6.1)`
- amira: `profile: info (N6.1)`
- mateo: `profile: pass`

## SPEC reference

SPEC §16 and D7 make Amira and Mateo part of the demo. SPEC §12 and spec-factors §20.9 say each review prints one `profile:` line. Nothing in the spec supports a demo with two profile lines.

## What is needed

A human decision to update `tests/test_lanes.py::test_cli_demo_prints_a_profile_line_per_review`, then re-freeze. One option is to assert the four lines above. Another is to assert one line per report (`len(profile_lines) == number of reports`) and that the first two equal `PROFILE_LINE`.

I changed no engine, pipeline or frozen test code.

- N3 (Mateo) and N6 (Amira, Mateo) hand-written entries in `fixtures/llm_cache/`, written by `scripts/handwrite_llm_cache.py`. Existing entries are byte-identical.
